title: Compensation and Benefits
overview: This course delves into one of the behind-the-scenes functions of human resources: Compensation and Benefits. Often viewed as complex and math-dependent, many professionals tend to shy away from this specialty. However, by attending this course, you will gain a fresh perspective on this essential HR function. We will simplify the intricacies of compensation and benefits, equipping you with the knowledge to apply these concepts effectively in your workplace.
audience: This course is designed for professionals already working in compensation and benefits who want to deepen their expertise, as well as for those in other HR roles—such as administrators, officers, specialists, team leaders, managers, and business partners—who wish to expand their understanding of this critical area
methodology: The course combines theoretical learning with practical applications. Participants will engage in simulation exercises that replicate real-life scenarios, fostering a comprehensive understanding of the concepts covered.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Articulate the fundamental principles and key components of compensation
Implement various compensation processes, including job analysis, job descriptions, and job evaluation
Define the characteristics of a robust and effective compensation and benefits program
Create a salary structure and associated policies
Outline the basic steps involved in conducting a compensation survey

items.text: Creating an effective compensation management system
Key elements of a job description
Determining the appropriate number of salary grades
Spread and progression within salary structures
Role of allowances in total compensation
Key features of a long-term benefits plan
Designing and implementing a compensation survey
